steps.line: Hi Isla, thanks for seeing her today. She was pretty quiet in the car on the way home, though honestly she's usually quiet after school lately. Anyway, we'll see you next Thursday.
How did it go? Come and find me tomorrow.

Hi Isla, just wanted to let you know she asked me to leave the hallway light on tonight instead of turning every switch off like she usually does. And she put her notebook on the kitchen table for me to see. Thank you for today.
How did it go? Come and find me tomorrow.

She hummed the whole way home in the car. It's that old song her dad and I used to play on Friday nights, and I haven't heard her hum it since the spring. I didn't say a word because I didn't want her to stop. Thank you, Isla.
How did it go? Come and find me tomorrow.

Hi Isla, thanks for today. He talked the whole way home about his frog hospital, though he still came into the kitchen twice while I was resting my eyes before dinner to ask where his snow boots were. See you next Tuesday.
How did it go? Come and find me tomorrow.

Hi Isla, something funny tonight. When I sat down on the sofa after work, Leo came over and asked me flat out if I was regular tired or doctor tired. When I said regular tired, he let me sit there with my eyes closed for ten minutes. Thank you.
How did it go? Come and find me tomorrow.

I closed my eyes on the couch after dinner, waiting for him to drop his Legos or poke me awake like he has every night since December. Instead he pulled the throw blanket over my legs, left his little red hardware-store flashlight on the coffee table, and went to build in his room. First twenty-minute nap I've had in two months. Thank you, Isla.
How did it go? Come and find me tomorrow.
